claims.text: The Jasper architecture serves as a good baseline approach for exploring more sophisticated methods.
The Hub5 Year 2000 (Hub5'00) evaluation is widely used as a baseline in academia.
Jasper was evaluated on the LibriSpeech and Wall Street Journal datasets, which serve as baselines for performance comparison.
